bio.text: Heather Matson is a Democratic state representative for Iowa House District 42; she served in the Iowa House in the 88th General Assembly (beginning 2019) and again since 2023.

The Iowa Legislature's 2023 biography lists Matson as a political, governmental affairs and nonprofit professional, with a B.A. in government from Western New England College and an M.A. in legislative affairs from George Washington University.
It says Matson was born in 1976 in Woonsocket, Rhode Island, lives in Ankeny, and serves on the boards of the Ankeny Kiwanis Club and the Ankeny Service Center.
